Thallam Venkata Subba Rao, S/o Thallam  Subbamangaiah, aged about 57 years, R/o  Flat No.107, SS Paradise, YMR Colony,
 Proddatur, YSR (Kadapa) District and four  others.

... Petitioners  Versus  The State of Andhra Pradesh, Rep. by its  Principal Secretary, Roads and Buildings  Department, Secretariat, Velagapudi, Guntur  District - 522 001 and six others.
 ...

The grievance of the petitioners is that respondent No.3 to 7 gave marking to petitioners' respective rooms/shops SRSJ bearing door Nos.14/110, 13/599, 14/102,
14/103 and 13/596/597 situated at Mydukur Road, Proddatur, YSR (Kadapa)
District, without issuing any notice and is taking steps to demolish the structure.

2. Heard learned counsel on either side.
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that without following the procedure mandated under Section 174 of the Andhra Pradesh Municipalities Act 1965 (for short the 'Act') or The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013,

sentences.text: 4. Learned standing counsel, on instructions of Commissioner of respondent No.5 would submit that road widening process is being undertaken and the authorities gave markings.
He would further submit that authorities are not demolishing the structure.
The authority will issue notice and follow due process in accordance with the Act.
SRSJ 5.

In view of the instructions of the Commissioner of respondent No.5, this writ petition is disposed of at the stage of admission, directing the authorities to follow the procedure contemplated under the Act, i.e. issuing notice, considering explanation, if necessary, by providing opportunity of hearing etc., before demolishing the structures bearing door Nos.14/110, 13/599, 14/102, 14/103 and 13/596/597 situated at Mydukur Road, Proddatur, YSR (Kadapa) District.
No costs.
As a sequel, pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.
__ JUSTICE SUBBA REDDY SATTI Date : 17.11.2023
ikn SRSJ
